defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) (hosting, deployment, PaaS, shopware-cli) and the shopware-cli reference, retrieved 2026-08-20.

cli.title: shopware-cli
cli.description: shopware-cli: extension build, validate and zip, project commands, account and store upload, the full command reference, MCP server. Use when the request names shopware-cli.
cli.intro: The official CLI for building extensions and driving a project. Each command's flags are in the reference file.

hosting.title: Shopware self-hosting
hosting.description: Shopware self-hosted operations: requirements, installation, webserver, database, search, HTTP caching, S3, env config, worker and cron, performance, observability, updates, deployment.
hosting.intro: Running Shopware on your own infrastructure. Ordered as you would set a server up: requirements first, deployment last.

paas.title: Shopware PaaS
paas.description: Shopware PaaS: fundamentals, getting started, environments, build and deploy, services, cron and worker, CDN, monitoring, scaling, composable frontends. Use when the request names Shopware PaaS.
paas.intro: Shopware's managed platform. The build and deploy model differs fundamentally from self-hosting — read fundamentals before anything else.

tooling.title: Shopware development tooling
tooling.description: Shopware development tooling: IDE setup, file watchers, the fixture bundle, Symfony Flex recipes, the DAL reference. Use when setting up a Shopware development environment.
tooling.intro: What makes local development bearable: watchers, IDE integration and fixtures.

support.title: Shopware troubleshooting
support.description: Shopware troubleshooting: diagnosing installation, cache, permission, performance and worker problems. Use when a Shopware shop misbehaves and the cause is unclear.
support.intro: Symptom-first diagnosis for a shop that will not behave.
